semiconductor_relevance: High — Assist-Navi specializes in contract manufacturing services for MEMS and semiconductor R&D, making it a relevant player in the semiconductor industry.
summary: Assist-Navi Co., Ltd. provides contract manufacturing services with a focus on MEMS and semiconductor research and development. Their offerings include high-aspect ratio lithography, film deposition technologies, etching, plating, and laser processing, catering to various microfabrication needs.
